messages:
maya: Quick sync 1: designing the auto-fallback UX. Need defaults that9re safe + auditable.

chris: Top-level UI: mode selector (soft/hard/sampled), traffic slider with canary presets, triggers summary, audit toggle. Advanced JSON behind an \u2018advanced\u2019 link.

linh: Visible knobs: fallback_pct (5/20/100), cooldown_sec, trigger_window, error/latency thresholds, dry-run. Per-region scope.

product_ana: Audit must record decision_id, policy_version, trigger_snapshot, and operator_id for manual overrides. Exportable JSON/CSV.

maya: Safety: two-step confirm for >50% or hard switchover; justification box recorded. Oscillation detector: >3 flips in 10m surfaces recommendation.

ops-bot: Example override curl for docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/rollouts/override \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"decision_id":"auto-1839999999-01","override_action":"route_canary","justify":"incident","manual":true}'
```

linh: Event keys to emit: decision_id, policy_version, trigger_reason, trigger_values, action, affected_region, trace_link. Keep blobs external.

chris: Telemetry names: rollout.decision, rollout.replay, rollout.override, rollout.oscillation. Include severity + retention class.

product_ana: UX: plain-language explain view + raw numbers on hover. Also show estimated cost delta when fallback applies.

maya: Replay UX: timeline of decisions, click -> open trace -> replay against stored metric slices in sandbox. Mark match/mismatch.

chris: Next: linh to draft event-schema PR, maya will write acceptance tests, product_ana drafts customer notes, ops-bot creates RFC.

ops-bot: RFC stub created: go/redwood/rfcs/auto-fallback-ui-2024 (draft).
